comment: Exception reason policy for Meridian Flow. legacy_code is the HOLDXTRT code from the retired Payments Review Desk. Reasons without a legacy_code were introduced after the desk was retired.

reasons.title: Beneficiary name does not match the registered record
reasons.description: The name on the payment instruction does not match the beneficiary legal name held on the customer record. The payment is held so operations can confirm which name the customer intended before the funds are released.
required_evidence: Instructed beneficiary name from the payment
Customer or relationship-manager confirmation of the correct name

reasons.title: Beneficiary account identifier is invalid
reasons.description: The account identifier on the instruction does not match a registered beneficiary account, or it fails the rail's format check.
required_evidence: Confirmation the account is still open

reasons.title: Beneficiary BIC is missing
reasons.description: A cross-border or correspondent payment was received without a BIC the rail can route on.

reasons.title: Possible duplicate end-to-end reference
reasons.description: Another payment for the same customer already uses this end-to-end reference. The hold stops a second settlement of the same instruction.
required_evidence: Confirmation this instruction is a new payment and not a replay

reasons.title: Amount exceeds the customer daily limit
reasons.description: The USD equivalent exceeds the customer's configured daily payment limit.

reasons.title: Settlement cutoff was missed
reasons.description: The payment arrived after the rail cutoff for the requested value date and was rolled forward.

reasons.title: Screening review required
reasons.description: The payment matched a screening indicator and must be reviewed by Financial Crime Risk before it can move.

reasons.title: Insufficient available balance
reasons.description: The debit account does not have enough available balance to cover the principal and the fee.

reasons.title: Value date is stale
reasons.description: The requested value date is in the past relative to the scenario clock and the rail calendar.

reasons.title: Purpose code is missing
reasons.description: The rail requires a purpose code and the instruction did not include one.

reasons.title: Currency is not supported on this rail
reasons.description: The instructed currency cannot be settled on the selected rail.

reasons.title: Foreign-exchange quote has expired
reasons.description: The quote used to price a cross-currency payment expired before the payment was released. There is no legacy desk code for this reason.
